verdict.rationale: Vue's docs and official ecosystem (Router, Pinia, compiler-optimized reactivity, tooling guide) claim it scales from simple to full-featured apps, and some devs confirm satisfaction at scale (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13). However, multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict the large-app maintainability claim: 'Vue is good for simple things... do not shines for complex apps' (vue-comm-7), 'for really complex applications, it's too magical' (vue-comm-18), Vuex state 'breaks modularity' and causes 'implicit state changes wrecking havoc' (vue-comm-19, vue-comm-20), and mediocre TypeScript support which large codebases rely on (vue-comm-3, vue-comm-15, vue-comm-17). Missing for 10: independent large-scale case studies or benchmarks refuting these complaints, stronger TS-at-scale evidence.
